name: Karatachi
source:
[i]"Well, aren't you the lucky young man. To be acquainted with such a lovely lady. I might even be a little jealous."[/i]

The general of the Kurozuru. He behaves and dresses in a carefree manner unbefitting of his title, and his subordinates are often at the mercy of his whims.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
